variants_of_the_developer_plan.unresolved: RESOLVED 2026-09-04 - see RESOLVED_2026_09_04. It was a floor band, not a revision. The ±25 mm note still stands for everything else.

RESOLVED_2026_09_04.answer: !!! IT IS NOT A REVISION DIFFERENCE. IT IS A FLOOR-BAND DIFFERENCE, and the BASIC plan (3Б/2+, 69.44) is the one that matches THIS FLAT on the 4th floor.
RESOLVED_2026_09_04.owner_evidence: The owner: the DETAILED plan draws TWO ventilation shafts together, which is specific to floors 10 and up. His flat is on the 4th, so it has ONE section in each place.
RESOLVED_2026_09_04.arithmetic_that_closes_it: The repo already recorded that the doubled section appears in BOTH places - the туалет and between the kitchen zone and the laundry/hallway zone. туалет +0.18 and прихожая +0.18 = 0.36, against a total delta of 0.35. So the 0.35 m² IS the two second vent sections at ~0.18 m² each.
RESOLVED_2026_09_04.independently_confirmed: Measured on the plans themselves: V2 is 400 × 1140 = 0.456 m² on the detailed plan and 421 × 685 = 0.288 m² on the basic one - a difference of 0.168 m², which lands on the 0.18 predicted from the area deltas. The 200 mm offset from the top wall and the x extent agree on both plans, so registration is not the cause; the shaft is genuinely shorter.
RESOLVED_2026_09_04.which_plan_for_what: USE THE BASIC PLAN for the vent shafts, the туалет and прихожая areas, and the total - it is this flat. USE THE DETAILED PLAN for every dimension, because it is still the ONLY dimensioned source. ⚠ But treat its vent-shaft footprints and its туалет/прихожая areas as the WRONG SUB-TYPE.
